small_guidance: Reduce register pressure in conv_transpose3d_kernel: the inner IC loop with 128 regs/thread caps occupancy at 33%. Hoist the w_off base outside the IC loop and reuse, swap loop order so IC is innermost over a vectorized BLOCK_IC tile loaded once per (kd,kh,kw), and try BLOCK_OC=16/BLOCK_SPATIAL=128 with num_warps=4, num_stages=2 to drop registers below 64. Also fuse the bn_sum + mean-subtract into a single two-pass kernel (one program per (N,OC) channel) to eliminate the intermediate sum_buf write/read.
large_guidance: Redesign the conv_transpose as a gather-based GEMM: one program per (N, output-spatial tile, OC tile) computing acc = Σ_{ic,kd,kh,kw} W[ic,oc,kd,kh,kw] * X[n,ic,id,ih,iw] via tl.dot, with K = IC*KD*KH*KW reduced in BLOCK_K=16/32 chunks. Use channels_last layout for X so IC is contiguous along K. Fold BatchNorm (eval-style affine using running stats) and the spatial mean-subtract epilogue into a separate fused kernel that does one program per (N,OC) channel performing two-pass mean over the full DHW volume and writes (x*scale+shift)-mean in one pass — eliminating cudnn BN, bn_sum, bn_meansub. Pick tiles BM=64,BN=64,BK=16,num_warps=4,num_stages=2 to stay within the 80KB SMEM budget.
